LanguageData.LP_LichGene.label: lich soul core
LanguageData.LP_LichGene.description: The lich archite gene. Psychic sensitivity +25%, biological aging stops. After completing the necromantic ritual, gains phylactery binding, psyfocus repair and necromantic command. The ritual automatically adds this xenogene and keeps all endogenes and xenogenes from before the transformation, without clearing or replacing the original genes.
